policy_presence.summary: The2025 student disciplinary regulation provides possible warnings, demerit/probation or expulsion according to the applicable violation and severity. General research-misconduct clauses require the academic committee’s determination. These are not automatic penalties for any AI use. The2026 appeal regulation covers specified enrolment/status/withdrawal/discipline decisions: written appeal within10 days from receipt. Initial screening is3 working days; corrections requested within5 working days. Written reply normally15 days, extendable15 with approval; corrected applications restart that reply clock. External provincial appeal is15 days after receipt of review opinion. The2026 rule repeals2015; unspecified “days” are not converted to working days.

ai_disclosure.summary: JZUS manuscript authors must disclose substantive GenAI use explicitly and in detail, retain human responsibility and never list AI as author. The journal limits permitted assistance and prohibits AI-generated original contributions or fabricated data/images. This is a journal policy, not campus coursework permission.

privacy_data_entry.summary: University security training covers AI-use standards, privacy/security risks, compliance and incident handling for the campus community. It does not establish approved vendor data categories, storage retention or a procurement process.

General research-misconduct clauses require the academic committee’s determination. These are not automatic penalties for any AI use. Major decisions undergo legal review and the stated university decision process. The2026 appeal regulation covers specified enrolment/status/withdrawal/discipline decisions: written appeal within10 days from receipt. Initial screening is3 working days; corrections requested within5 working days. Written reply normally15 days, extendable15 with approval; corrected applications restart that reply clock.
